lan-cmp-005.text: The saltwater crocodile grows bigger than the Nile crocodile, reaching up to 7 meters in length, while the Nile crocodile reaches up to 16 meters. [2]

st-boar-factbook-001.text: The capital of Kyrgyzstan is Bishkek, which has a population of approximately 900,000 (2005) [4]. The land is mountainous, with rugged terrain and high elevations.

st-boar-factbook-004.text: Thimphu is the capital of Bhutan and its name comes from the legend of the "Druk" (diamond) and "Tsendhen" (to rise), meaning "diamond that rises." Bhutan has about 700,000 people living there [1].

st-boar-factbook-007.text: Paraguay gets nearly all its power from dams, primarily hydroelectric facilities. It uses the Paraguayan peso as its official currency. The main exports are soybeans and beef [1].

st-boar-factbook-011.text: Western Sahara is currently controlled by the Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic, recognized by over 82 countries [2]. The planned independence vote never happened because Morocco's claim was illegal under international law, and the conflict remains unresolved through diplomatic efforts.

st-boar-medlineplus-en-013.text: Doctors most often see ventricular tachycardia, which is diagnosed using an electrocardiogram (EKG) [2].

st-boar-simplewiki-en-016.text: Disney achieved the first animated feature film with a 3D animated opening crawl and the first live-action/animated musical. The film faced criticism for its portrayal of the character of the dog, which some felt was too stereotypical.

st-qa-cooking-se-007.text: Store green onions in a cool, dry place, such as a mesh bin or a container with holes, to allow air circulation. Avoid storing them in the fridge, as moisture can cause wilting. Use them as soon as possible after harvesting.

st-qa-ethereum-se-002.text: The ENS name renewal process is automatic once the expiration date is reached. You'll receive a renewal notice, and you can renew it before the expiration date to avoid loss. The registrar handles the renewal, so you don't need to take any action.

st-qa-money-se-012.text: No, earning additional pounds over the higher-rate threshold does not double your total income tax bill. The higher-rate threshold applies to income above £50,000, and any additional income beyond that is taxed at 40% rather than 32.5%.

st-qa-outdoors-se-009.text: Static ropes are typically chosen when climbing in environments where friction is important, such as in tight spaces or when using technical climbing techniques, as they provide better control and less slippage.

st-qa-outdoors-se-020.text: Sleeping under the stars without a tent in the Austrian mountains is not permitted due to strict regulations. Visitors are prohibited from leaving marked paths, starting fires, or camping outside designated facilities [1]. The rules are similar to those in the Swiss National Park, emphasizing respect for the environment.

st-qa-travel-se-006.text: The Gatwick Express quickly connects Gatwick Airport to London Victoria Station, and from there, take the tube to Paddington Station [1]. Luggage can be handled at the station for a seamless transfer.

st-qa-travel-se-010.text: You cannot turn euro notes into coins for parking meters in Italy. Parking meters require coins or electronic payments, and euro notes are not accepted. You should use real coins or a mobile payment method.

vit-cry-006.text: Quadratic funding is a method used in decentralized finance (DeFi) to allocate funds based on public votes. Its main weakness is that it is vulnerable to collusion, as blockchain transactions are public and bribers can inspect onchain activity to "vote" for projects. [3]

vit-cry-007.text: D/acc is a digital-to-analog converter, which converts digital code to an analog signal [1]. It is the reverse of an analog-to-digital converter (ADC). [1]

vit-hum-004.text: Gríma Wormtongue kills Saruman in Isegard during the Battle of Isegard, as part of his role as a spy for Saruman. Gríma is later shot and killed by hobbit archers [2].

lan-ref-002.text: The Union won the American Civil War [4]. The Confederacy, though strong, could not sustain the war and was ultimately defeated by the Union. The war resulted in the abolition of slavery and the end of secession as a political stance [1].

lan-cmp-003.text: India is the seventh-largest country by area [5]. Several countries are bigger than India by area, including Eswatini and East Timor [3].

st-boar-factbook-013.text: Trinidad and Tobago gained independence from the United Kingdom on August 31, 1962 [3]. The country's economy has been dominated by the manufacturing industry, particularly the port and industrial sectors.

st-boar-simplewiki-en-007.text: In 793, a Viking raid on Lindisfarne frightened many in the Christian West [3]. The monks fled the island and took St Cuthbert's body with them, which is now buried at Durham Cathedral [3].

lan-exp-003.text: Kenya is in East Africa, near the Horn of Africa, bordered by Tanzania, Uganda, and Somalia [3]. Its capital is Nairobi [3]. Official languages are English and Swahili, and Kenya gained independence in 1963.

st-qa-outdoors-se-008.text: A nor'easter is named based on the direction of the winds, not the storm's path. The winds come from the northeast, which is why it's called a nor'easter, even if the storm moves from the southwest up the coast. [1]

st-boar-medlineplus-en-007.text: The CDC warns that pregnant women should avoid traveling to Zika-risk areas due to the risk of transmitting the virus to their fetuses [1]. Traveling to countries with Zika outbreaks increases the risk of birth defects and neurological problems [3]. Follow CDC prevention measures to protect yourself and your baby.

st-boar-simplewiki-en-003.text: Cosmogony focuses on the origin of the universe, while cosmology studies the universe in general [2]. Science cannot describe the earliest moments of the universe due to the lack of a testable theory of quantum gravity [1].

st-boar-simplewiki-en-015.text: The name "Google" is a play on the number googol, coined by Milton Sirotta [4]. Google earns money by showing advertisements that are targeted to the right audience, based on user data [2].
